text:
sam: Quick check — starting an experiment to add a compressed host staging pool to reduce offload I/O and fragmentation. RFC follow-up notes. TL;DR: compressed pages in host with lightweight LRU, evict compressed->GPU async decompress.

maria: +1. what's the expected CPU overhead for compress/decompress? Do we target LZ4? :thinking_face: 

sam: LZ4 by default, we measured ~0.8us/KB decompression on p4d. For 32KB pages that's ~25us, ok for background warmups. Compression ratio ~2-3x for kv-cache tensors.

ryan: How will this affect latency tail? Any synchronous paths?

sam: Plan: write compressed pages to staging pool async. On cache miss we attempt async decompress; if request is latency critical we fallback to streaming from disk/GPU without blocking. Need API: alloc_flags { compress_staging: bool, eager_decompress: bool }

anya: For SRE we need to expose compressed_byte_metrics and cpu_cycles_per_decompress in console. Also a knob to disable for low-cpu nodes.

maria: boundary question: who owns the lifecycle? runtime or allocator? my vote: allocator owns compression decisions, runtime handles migration and KV cache semantics.

sam: Agreed. allocator will maintain compressed metadata per allocation -> small header: [orig_size, comp_size, algo, crc]

sam: config snippet:
```
staging_pool:
  enabled: true
  compress: lz4
  compression_cpu_limit_pct: 20
  max_pool_bytes: 12GB
```

ryan: eviction policy — if compressed pool full do we demote to disk spill or evict to disk? tradeoffs?

sam: strategy: try to spill to NVMe (higher cost) else evict and free. We can also age-heavy items -> hard to pick. Need experiments.

maria: fragmentation: compressed blocks are variable sized. allocator needs small-block packing + free-list with coalescing. Might need a compacting thread.

anya: security/compliance: compressed data must be zeroed on free and optionally encrypted at rest when Private deployments.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/comp-staging-experiment -> infra-test

sam: Next steps: run 2-week A/B on a few tenant classes, watch p99 token latency, CPU, nvme write rate, memory fragmentation delta. Any other concerns?

ryan: add metric: decompress_count_per_req and tail_decompress_time. Also add a canary that disables compress if tail > 5ms.

maria: I'll prototype allocator headers + packing. Sam, can you add a small perf harness? I'll instrument.

sam: cool. I'll create a short RFC addendum with API and config. Thanks all :thumbsup:
